messages:
emily (sec): Quick heads-up — planning a flat-image lockdown rebuild for the runtime base images next Tue. Primary goals: shrink attack surface (remove optional packages), enable cosign/KMS signing rotation, enforce image policy at the registry, and wire audit events to SIEM. Need to lock down RBAC for the signer and make sure vuln triage can gate the canary. Who's available to coordinate?

omar (eng-runtime): I can lead runtime-side changes. Question: do we want a single cosign signer key per env or per pool?

emily (sec): Prefer per-env for blast radius. prod gets its own key + signer SA. staging/test can share a separate key. Also want audit events for signing/attestation forwarded as structured logs.

rachel (infra): On the KMS side, we'll need to add the signer SA to the key's policy and ensure Cloud Audit Logs are exported to the SIEM sink. I can handle the sink config but need the exact SA email and required role.

omar (eng-runtime): The SA will be `cosign-signer@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` for prod. Role should be `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier` (or `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner` depending on cloud). We also need the runtime service account to read attestation metadata from the artifact registry.

emily (sec): Jin, can you confirm what audit events we need retained and which fields are critical for incident response? E.g., signer identity, key version, image digest, build id, deploy user.

jin (vuln-triage): For triage and regression alerts we need: signing.subject (SA), cryptoKeyVersion, cosign signature timestamp, image digest, linked CVE list at time-of-sign, and builder metadata (CI job id). Retention: 1 year searchable, 7 years archived would be ideal for regulated customers.

alex (releases): From release side: canary flow — we want pre-signed canary images pushed to a `canary/` tag, promoted on success. If signing blocks push, we need an emergency override path. How do we do an auditable override?

emily (sec): Emergency override should be a short-lived cosign key with HSM-protected access and explicit approval from two approvers logged in the SIEM. Prefer avoid manual re-sign; better to allow deploy with `--skip-sign` only via a ticket automation that creates a temporary allowlist entry (logged).

omar (eng-runtime): Implementation notes: we'll update buildkite step to call `cosign sign` and `cosign attest` with the relevant builder annotations. For key rotation: rotate by creating a new cryptoKeyVersion and migrating signers, then sign a small batch of images to validate.

sec-ci-bot: Artifact scan results for branch `flat-image-lockdown` — new vuln delta: 2 medium (libnss 3.75), 1 low. No criticals. Full report: https://ci.internal/reports/3309876543

jin (vuln-triage): Seen the report. libnss update blocks the rebuild until we validate downstream consumers. I'll open a quick eval run against internal services. If patch causes failures, we'll pin in staging and escalate.

rachel (infra): RBAC snippet for GCP KMS policy I will apply (preview):

```
- members:
  - serviceAccount:cosign-signer@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
  role: roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier
```

I'll also add an audit sink: `projects/redwood-prod/sinks/kms-signing-audit` -> BigQuery/SIEM.

omar (eng-runtime): For registry policy, we'll enforce attestation validation in the admission controller (Gatekeeper). Pseudocode: `if not has_valid_cosign_attestation(image) deny` — will push a PR to the admission repo.

emily (sec): Timeline proposal:
- Mon: infra applies KMS RBAC + audit sink (rachel)
- Tue: runtime changes + buildkite cosign step (omar)
- Wed: push flat-image canary, triage vuln deltas (jin)
- Thu: if canary good, promote and rotate signer key version (emily/rachel)

alex (releases): I'll reserve a deploy window Thu afternoon and prepare rollback hooks. Reminder: include `--dry-run` signing and smoke deploy to k8s nodes in staging first.

omar (eng-runtime): A couple of operational Qs: 1) How do we handle old images signed with rotated keys? admission should accept old key versions for X days. 2) Do we want cosignful attestation (predicate) or just signature verification?

emily (sec): 1) Keep previous key versions trusted for 30 days during rollout. 2) Predicate attestation preferred (build info, SBOM link). Start with signature + minimal attestation, then iterate.

jin (vuln-triage): I'll prepare a minimal eval set (10 services) to run smoke tests against canary image. Will post results in this thread.

sec-ci-bot: Gate status: required approval `infra/kms-policy` pending from rachel.

rachel (infra): Acknowledge. Applying RBAC preview in staging today, will schedule prod apply Tue morning.

emily (sec): Thanks everyone. I'll collect PR links and create the rollout checklist in the runbook repo. Ping here if blockers. :thumbsup:
